gitCommit.subject: v2.15.401: an incomplete entry-requirement read cannot be approved (E13) (#793)
gitCommit.body:
v2.15.401: an incomplete entry-requirement read cannot be approved (E13) (#793)

* E13: whole-read completeness gate for course entry-requirement reads

Platform Admin approval 2 Nov 2026 05:18 (E13). A course entry read is proposed whole or held whole, and an incomplete read never reaches
approval.

- Reader (security.enrich_entry_record_v1, md5-guarded replacement): rows over the course's limit hold the whole read (held_partial,
  over_row_limit); nothing is proposed and every row read is kept on the item. Rows about another programme are dropped as
  other_programme and do not count towards the limit.
- Approval (security.course_entry_review_apply_v1, md5-guarded edit): Approve and Approve except are refused with nothing changed while
  security.course_entry_gate_v1 finds rows cut by the limit (joined conditions named), a waiting row about another programme, or a page
  shared with a differently named programme. Reject is unchanged.
- Review screen (security.aer_review_read_v1 edit and Layer 4 Inbox): the gate's reasons are shown, rows about another programme are
  marked, and the approvals the server would refuse cannot be chosen.
- Settings (G2): entry.max_rows_by_provider, entry.joined_condition_words, entry.joined_condition_kinds, entry.variant_check,
  entry.shared_page_hold, entry.variant_check_off_providers, entry.award_abbreviations. entry.max_rows_per_course stays 6.
- Tests: s213 contract and mocked-browser spec; isolated fixtures (tests/fixtures/e13-completeness-gate) run on a scratch PostgreSQL
  that rebuilds the live definitions from this repository's migrations and checks their md5s.

No re-read, no AI or page fetch, nothing approved, withdrawn or re-opened. No version bump.
